Multiple Road Accidents Kill Motorcyclists Across India

In Jalandhar Cantt, a road accident occurred when a tipper truck collided with a motorcycle, resulting in the death of one young man and injuries to another. In Surajpur, Madhya Pradesh, a young man from MP died in a road accident involving a collision between a speeding pickup vehicle and a motorcycle. In Varanasi, a motorcyclist died after their bike collided with a divider, in an area where accidents have reportedly happened before.
